LESSON: ADDITION

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Numbers
Topic 1.4: Addition

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Addition. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LOOK AND LEARN

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-032.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 32]]

From your pupil's book (page 32)

Activity 1 What is 23 + 5? Count on 5 steps from 23; 24, 25, 26, 27, 28 23 + 5 = 28 Activity 2 Work out 23 + 5 = Write as 23 + 5 Count on 5 steps from 23; 28 24, 25, 26, 27, 28

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-047.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 47]]

From your pupil's book (page 47)

NUMBERS MULTIPLICATION Week 7 Lesson 2 Repeated addition Activity 1 Write as repeated addition

and is 1 + 1 = 2 Activity 2 Write as repeated addition

2 + 2 = 4 Work to do Write the missing number

1. and is 3 + ________ = ________ 2. and is

3. and is ________ + ________ = ________ 35

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-096.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 96]]

From your pupil's book (page 96)

Activity What is 14 + 8? Steps + 8 = 14 + 6 + 2 • Break apart 8 as 6 + 2 = 20 + 2 • Add 6 to 14 to get 20 = 22 • Add 2 to 20 to get 22 + 8 = 22 Work to do Add 1. 1 9 + 5 = 2. 1 5 + 8 =

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Addition means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Addition.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Addition
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
3. Learning materials: Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2
4. Revise with the quiz now.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
